subject: Genesis POC: tenant bootstrap & network timeline
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@genesis.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: cloudops@genesis.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Genesis POC — org bootstrap & network timeline

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Genesis is excited to move to a short POC to validate latency/cost for our inference workloads. We put together a first-pass MAP and a quick SOC2 summary attached. High level asks to align on before we start:

- Tenant/org creation and scoped API key for a staging tenant
- IP allowlist for our staging cluster (we'll provide CIDR)
- VPC peering (we prefer an L3 peering; can accept a peering connection or transit if required)
- Expected timing for key issuance + peering (we're targeting a 2-week runway)

Can your team confirm the minimum firewall rules/ports for model inference and any required NAT/Egress behavior? Also let us know whether Redwood supports a short-lived API key that we can rotate for the POC.

I attached the MAP_Genesis_v2.xlsx (outline of milestones) and genesis-SOC2-summary.pdf. Proposing a 30-minute kickoff Thursday 11/13 at 11am PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Alex Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships
Genesis AI

Attachments: MAP_Genesis_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), genesis-SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@genesis.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Genesis POC — org bootstrap & network timeline

Alex — thanks for the note and the materials, useful context. Thursday 11/13 11am PT works for me; I'll send a calendar invite.

Quick summary of what we can commit for the POC and a proposed timeline:

- Week 0 (11/13): kickoff, confirm MAP milestones and contact matrix.
- Week 1 (11/14–11/20): Redwood creates a staging org and issues a scoped API key with read/generate tokens limited to the POC models.
- Week 2 (11/18–11/21): VPC peering window and allowlist verification, run a short smoke test.
- Week 3 (11/24–11/28): performance run + cost snapshot, handoff to product team for evaluation.

Items I need from you before kickoff:
1) CIDR(s) for the staging subnet you plan to peer and any static egress IPs you expect to see.
2) If you require cross-account route propagation or specific ASN for BGP, please note.
3) Any compliance evidence besides the SOC2 summary that your procurement/Security wants up front.

Looping in Neha (security/compliance) to confirm firewall rules and Kim (solutions) to map the network steps.

If peering can't happen within the two-week window we can provision temporary allowlist entries for a day to run the smoke tests while the peering ticket is in flight.

—Jonas
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@genesis.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Genesis POC — org bootstrap & network timeline

Alex/Jonas — quick technical itemization from Security so procurement and CloudOps have clear actions: 

- Required outbound ports from Genesis staging to Redwood: TCP 443 (HTTPS) on standard ports; if you plan to use gRPC over TLS that is also 443.
- Inbound connections: none expected — our runtime initiates egress to your allowlisted IPs for callbacks only; we can support mutual TLS for callbacks if desired.
- Recommended allowlist entries from our side (you will need):
  - staging-api.redwood-inference.svc (resolved IPs will be provided once staging tenant is active)
  - If you use a NAT egress, please provide the static NAT IPs.
- VPC peering notes: we support both direct peering and transit GW attachments. For BGP peering we use ASN 64512 by default; we can support static routes if you prefer.
- API keys: we can emit a scoped key with limited model access and TTL (we support rotating keys programmatically). For the POC we suggest a 30-day TTL and one rotation mid-run.

Procurement note for Ben: if Genesis will request an SLA addendum for peering-related availability, flag the ask early so Sales can coordinate contract redlines.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
From: cloudops@genesis.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 16:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Genesis POC — org bootstrap & network timeline

Thanks — quick answers from CloudOps:

- CIDR for staging: 10.40.32.0/22 (this is the subnet we plan to peer).
- Preferred peering window: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 between 02:00–05:00 UTC (we're operating in a maintenance window then).
- We can provide two static egress IPs if you prefer allowlist entries instead of a full peering for early smoke tests: 34.210.45.19 and 34.210.45.20.
- We do not require BGP; static route announcement is fine for our transit config.
- For API keys: please issue an initial scoped key on 18 Nov so our engineers can run verify/connect tests ahead of the peering window.

Attached is the updated MAP spreadsheet with the peering window column filled (MAP_Genesis_v2.xlsx). We can also accept temporary allowlist access on 17–18 Nov for quick validation if that helps.

—CloudOps (Genesis)

Attachment: MAP_Genesis_v2.xlsx (updated)
